items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Renee Fleming is a world famous vocal soloist at the Met. She sang with my band, her first gig singing.

ctx.x: Renee Fleming is a world famous vocal soloist at the Met. She sang with my band, her first gig singing. No, no she sang in beer joints in Potsdam, but singing with a band, she sang with my band.
